summary: Rotary Club of Mumbai Sher-E-Punjab (RCMSEP) successfully completed the Charter Installation of the Interact Club of CP Goenka International School, Oshiwara, on 16th October 2026.
description: Rotary Club of Mumbai Sher-E-Punjab (RCMSEP) successfully completed the Charter Installation of the Interact Club of CP Goenka International School, Oshiwara, on 16th October 2026. The programme began with an introduction to RCMSEP by Rtn. Monica, followed by an insightful session on “What is an Interact Club in Rotary?” by Rtn. Satinderpal. The students and staff were inspired by Rotary’s impactful work across the globe. Rtn. Sunita Sharma discussed potential service projects for the newly formed Interact Club, encouraging students to take an active role in community service. The President, Secretary, Treasurer and SAA were formally pinned, marking the beginning of their leadership journey. The newly appointed President then shared her vision and aspirations for taking the club forward. The installation marked an important step towards nurturing young leaders and promoting the Rotary spirit of Service Above Self among students.
